questions.question: The number of international students _____ increasing every year.
questions.explanation_cn: 'The number of...' 作主语时，看作单数，因此用 is。
questions.explanation_en: 'The number of...' takes a singular verb.

questions.question: A number of university students _____ part-time jobs.
questions.explanation_cn: 'A number of...' 表示'许多……'，谓语动词用复数。
questions.explanation_en: 'A number of...' is followed by a plural verb.

questions.question: Each participant _____ required to complete the questionnaire.
questions.explanation_cn: Each 作主语时，谓语动词通常使用单数。
questions.explanation_en: 'Each' is singular and takes a singular verb.

questions.question: Neither the teacher nor the students _____ aware of the schedule change.
questions.explanation_cn: Neither...nor... 遵循就近原则，离谓语最近的是 students，因此用 are。
questions.explanation_en: With 'Neither...nor...', the verb agrees with the nearest subject.

questions.question: Research on climate change _____ become increasingly important over the past decade.
questions.explanation_cn: Research 是不可数名词，作主语时使用单数谓语。
questions.explanation_en: 'Research' is an uncountable noun and takes a singular verb.

questions.question: Not only the students but also the professor _____ expected to attend the conference.
questions.explanation_cn: Not only...but also... 同样遵循就近原则，最近的主语 professor 为单数，因此用 is。
questions.explanation_en: With 'Not only...but also...', the verb agrees with the nearest subject.

questions.question: Either the lecturers or the course coordinator _____ responsible for updating the timetable.
questions.explanation_cn: Either...or... 遵循就近原则，最近的主语 coordinator 为单数，因此使用 is。
questions.explanation_en: With 'Either...or...', the verb agrees with the nearest subject.

questions.question: One of the most important skills students _____ is critical thinking.
questions.explanation_cn: students 是定语从句中的先行词，因此从句谓语应用复数 need。
questions.explanation_en: The relative clause modifies 'students', so the verb should be plural: 'need'.

questions.question: Every teacher and every student _____ expected to attend the academic seminar.
questions.explanation_cn: Every...and every... 强调每一个个体，因此谓语动词使用单数。
questions.explanation_en: 'Every...and every...' takes a singular verb because each individual is emphasized.

questions.question: The news about the scholarship _____ encouraging.
questions.explanation_cn: news 虽然以 s 结尾，但属于单数不可数名词。
questions.explanation_en: 'News' ends in 's' but is grammatically singular.

questions.question: Which of the following sentences are grammatically correct?

options.text: The number of applicants has increased significantly.
A number of researchers are working on the project.
Every student and every teacher are required to register.
Neither the manager nor the employees were informed in advance.

questions.explanation_cn: A：The number of + 复数名词，谓语用单数。B：A number of + 复数名词，谓语用复数。C：错误，应为 Every...and every... is。D：就近原则，最近主语 employees 为复数，因此 were 正确。
questions.explanation_en: A is correct because 'The number of' takes a singular verb. B is correct because 'A number of' takes a plural verb. C is incorrect because 'Every...and every...' requires a singular verb. D is correct because the verb agrees with the nearest subject 'employees'.
